भ्रेज् भ्रेज् (allied to rt. 1. भ्राज्), cl. 1.
A. भ्रेजते, बिभ्रेजे, to shine, glitter,
gleam, &c.: Caus. भ्रेजयति, -यितुम्, अबिभ्रेजत्.

भ्रेष् भ्रेष् [cf. rts. भ्रंश्, ह्रेष्], cl.
1. P. A. भ्रेषति, -ते, बिभ्रेष, बि-
भ्रेषे, भ्रेषितुम्, to go, move; to totter, waver,
slip, fall, make a false step; to fear; to be angry.

भ्रेष, अस्, m. motion, going, proceeding; tot-
tering, wavering, slipping, falling, declining or falling
(from virtue), deviation (from rectitude), trespass,
sin; loss, deprivation.

भ्रेषण, अम्, n. the act of going, moving,
tottering, &c.
